name: Lianson Fleet Group Berhad
summary: Lianson Fleet Group Berhad is a Malaysia-based investment holding company that provides marine logistics and offshore support services to the oil and gas industry in Southeast Asia. The company's services cover the entire offshore oil and gas life cycle, from exploration and platform support to maintenance. Its fleet consists of offshore support vessels (OSVs), tugs and barges, and dry bulk carriers which also facilitate the transportation of dry bulk commodities.
